utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, what's this about a repair drive? I heard something about it at the store.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's a community thing I'm helping organize. We're collecting broken small appliances and tools to fix up on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great! Where should we drop off the stuff?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, did you finally get that repair drive fixed for the Johnson's car?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's done. Took a bit, but it's running fine now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good to hear, you're a lifesaver with that stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't seen any announcements.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly my point, Kira. Without an official notice, how can we be sure this is even legitimate?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, we should probably ask the HOA before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Cleo! I heard something about a repair drive, but I can't quite remember what that is... could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing, Oren! The repair drive is a community event where folks bring broken items to the community center and we fix 'em together instead of throwing them out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I've got a wobbly chair in my garage that I've been meaning to fix. When's it happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm ready to listen. What's the situation with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, repair drive? I think I forgot about that...

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You forgot? That's unlike you—are you sure there's nothing else we need to recover?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I heard about the repair drive. Sorry I'm late—what did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We're just getting started—everyone's chipping in to fix up the old playground equipment down the street.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear—I can grab my toolbox and help with the rusty swing set if that still needs work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you're organizing that neighborhood repair drive. Need any help setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Sam, I could use a hand sorting through some donated tools on Saturday morning. You free then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning works great for me. I'll swing by and help you get everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard you're organizing the repair drive—what's the exact location and time again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, it's at the community center this Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. I'm hoping we get a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I've noted that down. Do you need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old bikes!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yeah, I was just about to spread the word! My neighbor's got a rusty old cruiser that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think the church parking lot is the spot, from 10 to 4. Are you planning to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you find the right socket for that bolt yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I'm still looking through the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What size socket are you looking for? I might have one in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think I caught a little bit about it from across the fence—something about tools and helping out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we're collecting old tools and electronics to fix up and donate—I heard the Andersons are bringing their broken blender.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Rosa... I was wondering if maybe I could help with the sewing tasks. It's quiet work, and I need something to keep my hands busy right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Uli! We could really use someone with your skills. I'll make sure you have all the supplies you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, did you hear about the community repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old bikes and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard about it. I've already marked it on my calendar for Saturday morning — I like to have my weekend planned out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! I heard they'll have free coffee and pastries too — should be a fun morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane! We're just going over the list of tools we'll need—don't forget to bring that wrench you borrowed from Marty.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, the wrench! Almost left it behind—thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli, I heard you were working on the repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, it's coming along, I guess. Trying to keep busy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good, keeping busy helps. What's the hardest part of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about it. Needed any help?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it's in the garage at the corner of Maple and 3rd. Did you want to check it out together?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I've got a few minutes. Let's head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I heard you're organizing that repair drive for the community center—count me in to help spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's wonderful, Jules! Could you tell me which streets you'd be able to cover so I can mark them off my list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure! I can take Elm Street and the little loop around Maple Lane—I know most folks there from my morning walks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara, what's this about a repair drive? I thought we were just doing a yard sale thing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Well, Noah, we’re turning the yard sale into a repair drive too—folks can bring broken items, and we’ll try to fix them instead of tossing them into the landfill.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, fix things? Like, who's going to be doing the fixing? I mean, my toaster's been broken for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, heard you're heading up the repair drive? Need any help rounding up supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got a list going—wrenches, plywood, and some spare nails. Could use a hand gathering them up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can swing by the hardware store on my way back from the post office. Just text me the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing that repair drive. Need any help with tools or setup?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I could use an extra hand setting up the tables and sorting donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can bring my toolbox and help you sort everything out. When should I come over?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough volunteers to actually staff the repair drive next weekend? I don't want us to be overwhelmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have a headcount yet? I can reach out to a few people if we're short.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we're at about six confirmed, but we'd probably need at least ten to handle the expected crowd.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! Did you hear about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm spreading the word—everyone's welcome to come help out!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I heard about that! I've been checking my toolbox to see what spare parts I can donate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Cleo! I knew I could count on you. Don't forget to tell the Johnsons next door too—I think they've got some old equipment lying around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, I was thinking maybe we could combine the repair drive with the kids' after-school pickup next week — make it easier for parents to drop off items.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's a great idea, Faye! I'd completely forgotten about the after-school pickup schedule though — what time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Starts at 3:30 PM on weekdays, so we could set up a table near the pickup area from 3 to 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good morning, Nell! I'm so glad to see you. I wanted to discuss the details of our upcoming repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard bits and pieces from a few folks. What's the plan exactly?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we're gathering on Saturday morning at the community center — folks can bring their broken items and our handy volunteers will try to fix them together, free of charge!
